targetTest: a supervisor killed inside the block resumes to the same blocked state, and B is not run again
expected: the supervisor is killed at after-checkpoint:park, mid-park and after-release:blocked of an item-local block, and each resume reaches the blocked state of the uninterrupted S-17 run with B run once
actual: run against the code before the plan (a clean export of HEAD with the new test, the fault helper and the scenario helper copied in): there is no park step, no park checkpoint and no release of a blocked run, so the kill points are never reached; the reference run and the three kill cases fail on assertions or on the harness's check that the point killed the supervisor
semanticAssessment: The harness reports that the armed point was never reached (the run ends blocked at B with the whole run stopped, exit 3, no interrupted run), which is the missing behavior; the reference run fails on the item states (C is not done). Not an import or syntax error: the helper that names the points is copied in.
